## 30-Minute Meet & Greet  
**Connection First. No Pressure. No Pitch.**

This session is a casual introduction for people I connect with in real life, through referrals, events, or business conversations.

This is not a strategy session or a discovery call. It is simply a chance to connect, understand what you do, share what Luxora does at a high level, and explore whether there may be alignment now or in the future.

What this call is for:  
• Relationship building  
• Light overview of your business or idea  
• Exploring potential collaboration or future fit  

What this call is not for:  
• Deep strategy  
• Audits or growth planning  
• Detailed offer breakdowns  

If you are interested in exploring Luxora services or growth support in depth, please book a 45-Minute Growth Assessment instead.

---

## 45-Minute Growth Assessment  
**Discovery Call for Med Spa & Wellness Brands**

This is the primary discovery call for med spa and wellness owners who have reviewed Luxora’s work and want to explore a potential partnership.

This session is designed to assess your current market position, growth challenges, and opportunities before discussing any solutions.

During this call, we will:  
• Review your current services, goals, and constraints  
• Identify gaps in acquisition, conversion, retention, or systems  
• Discuss what is realistically possible in your market  
• Determine whether Luxora is the right growth partner for you  

This is not a coaching call and not a generic sales pitch. It is a focused assessment designed to bring clarity and determine fit.

This call is best suited for established businesses ready for structure, strategy, and execution support.

---

## 90-Minute Client Onboarding Session  
**Foundational Strategy & Execution Alignment**

This session is for **new Luxora clients only** and serves as the official start of our partnership.

This working session is where we align on goals, priorities, timelines, and execution strategy so implementation is clear, efficient, and intentional from day one.

During this session, we will:  
• Confirm growth objectives and success metrics  
• Review services, offers, and operational structure  
• Align on systems, communication, and expectations  
• Establish the strategic roadmap for the engagement  

Please come prepared with access to relevant platforms, documentation, and team insights as outlined in your onboarding instructions.

This session sets the foundation for everything that follows.

### Luxora Strategy Call  
**A Market-Led Growth Conversation for Established Med Spa & Wellness Brands**

This is not a sales call.

This is a strategic working session designed to evaluate your market position, identify growth constraints, and uncover where revenue is being limited or left on the table.

During this call, we will:

• Assess your current market position, offers, and growth ceiling  
• Identify operational or demand bottlenecks impacting scale and profitability  
• Review how acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value are currently working together (or not)  
• Determine whether The Luxora Collective is the right strategic partner for your next phase of growth  

Luxora works exclusively with established med spa and wellness brands that are ready to move beyond guesswork and reactive marketing into market-backed, data-driven growth.

If we are not the right fit, you will leave with clarity and direction.  
If we are the right fit, we will outline a clear path forward based on your market realities.

Please come prepared to discuss your current services, goals, and challenges openly so we can make the most of our time together.
